publicationGate.neededBeforeProduction: Document permission covering the intended training and derived-model production/commercial use, including any distribution, or select a source with verified compatible rights. Existing research use does not imply that permission.
publicationGate.trackedBy: MVP-ALG-013; intended-use permission or compatible replacement is required before any production training/serving proposal

sourceWithdrawalAndRebuild.scope: One source/release per store; tombstone denies loading every fitted model and deletes its statistics. A different permitted source requires a new complete run with new source/partition identity. Deleting raw files alone is insufficient.
sourceWithdrawalAndRebuild.fallback: No external model is exported to native serving. Existing native fallback remains; absent/disallowed/withdrawn models fail closed and separately supplied native grades retain their mean, including zero, or unavailable.
